scope: Nine selected donor suites consolidated into native Mattermost state, transition, isolation, text and form scenarios. Telegram fixtures and rendering assertions are replaced, not imported.
native_cases: nested transitions and result propagation survive storage reload
failed manager transactions do not commit
per-scope locks prevent lost concurrent updates
text conditions, fallback and case selection render deterministically
FormWindow emits typed Mattermost Form and TextInput declarations with cancel notification enabled
the documented OpenForm/FormWindow declaration and submit callback execute end to end
memory and real Redis storage/isolation profiles share the same session model
Back restores the actual branch path after persistence reload
multiple PagedList widgets keep independent page and filter state
large control sets remain in one object-local native attachment group
ButtonGrid and ActionRow preserve a two/four/two control structure in one group and compile it to Blocks columns
full and compact pagers retain stable disabled boundary controls
bounded Markdown tables escape cells and remain independently addressable
opaque cursor lists move forward and backward without a fabricated total
typed form presets cover text, choices, dates and files
DataBlock compiles a table, its filter and its full pager into one native attachment without a five-action cap
table filters render above content with active color while page selection and pagination share the lower row
page-local dropdown selection reveals a nested detail card below its table controls
determinate and indeterminate progress always include numeric status
DataBlock retains static content when every local action is hidden
generic Button callbacks consume a per-render token before application dispatch
typed form defaults resolve from Format, MagicFilter, sync and async getter data before native validation
ActionTable is a public Blocks-only row-action widget rather than demo-only imperative code
excluded: Telegram Bot, Chat, Message and CallbackQuery fixtures
inline/reply keyboard, content type, media ID and callback-answer assertions
editing an already open Mattermost modal in the background
